title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.05.2
notes:
- Select audio clips in the Playlist and use Normalize audio clips to enter a sample peak, RMS or integrated LUFS target. Each clip gets its own gain adjustment in one undoable edit.
- Settings > General > Miscellaneous now offers automatic mixer routing for Channel Rack samples. It starts off. Enable it to use an empty insert or add one while preserving existing routing and Playlist recordings.
- The Playlist gain handle now adjusts selected audio clips together by the same decibel amount. Pencil right-drag erases across clips, and the pulled-elastic-band Stretch tool sits beside Select.
- Analog is the default full mixer style for new preferences. Clean Modern and Analog show a subtle track color behind the insert number, and the full mixer mute buttons are larger and inset.
- Cut itself assigns an individual group to each sampler. The Browser keeps Favorites next to Samples and adds sample editor, slicer, file and searchable tag actions.
- Right-click Typing Keyboard to Piano to choose a key and scale independently of the Piano Roll. Rescanning can reconnect missing project instruments and mixer effects with their saved settings.
- Playlist display options include waveform detail, and the Piano Roll can quantize note starts at half strength.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
